points.description: Lists at least four distinct objectives of IPv6, each matching one from the model answer (or equivalent wording): support for billions of end-systems; reduced routing tables; simplified protocol processing via a simplified header; increased security; support for real-time traffic / quality of service (flow label, traffic class); multicasting; mobility (roaming); openness to future change (extension headers); coexistence with existing protocols. Repeated or vague items (e.g. 'better performance') do not count towards the four.

rubric.notes: The question asks for at least four objectives, so the full mark goes to a student who names four distinct, valid objectives from the model answer, in equivalent wording. Fewer than four valid distinct objectives earns no mark, as the single point is all-or-nothing. Do not require every objective in the model answer or its exact phrasing.
